intro: Discover the Adria bed—a masterpiece of stability and charm. Its robust metal frame and prelaminated board offer timeless elegance, making it a sanctuary for restful nights and stylish living.

features.title: Metal frame construction for durability
features.text: We didn’t compromise on strength. Built with a metal frame using MS channels and pipes, this piece delivers superior stability and everyday durability.

features.title: Prelaminated particle board panels
features.text: Strong, stylish, and built to last. Prelaminated particle board panels with melamine lamination resist wear while staying sleek.

features.title: Curved angle headboard for style
features.text: The headboard’s curved design adds a touch of elegance that transforms your bedroom into a stylish retreat.

features.title: Knockdown construction for portability
features.text: Move with ease—the knockdown design makes transportation simple and assembly a breeze.

features.title: Underbed storage for organised living
features.text: Need more storage? We’ve got you—underbed storage offers a practical solution for keeping essentials neatly tucked away.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
